containers.name: gsbmymo
containers.description: GoAnywhere MFT drop location, shared across multiple DV source files (e.g. MYMO_LOAN, MYMO_DEPOSIT) -- not exclusive to dv_loan_account.

containers.name: mymo_loan
containers.description: Loan account information for all loan accounts owned by MyMo users, daily batch (T-3). File: MYMO_LOAN_YYYYMMDD.TXT, HDT format (H=header, D=detail rows, T=tail), pipe-separated.

columns.name: part
columns.description: H (header), D (detail), or T (tail) -- HDT file format marker. Source doc names this column 'part' rather than 'row_type' (as the sibling deposit-account file calls the same marker) -- kept verbatim, see draft notes.

columns.name: account_number
columns.description: PII -- hashed with MD5 downstream in the safe Hive table. Max length 12; >=11 if account_group != DDA.

columns.name: credit_limit
columns.description: Numeric value stored as string. Source doc's schema table types this Decimal; typed STRING here at the raw-file level, matching the dv_deposit_account precedent -- see draft notes.

columns.name: ending_balance
columns.description: Numeric value stored as string -- see credit_limit note.

columns.name: payment_amount
columns.description: Numeric value stored as string -- see credit_limit note.

columns.name: fixed_principal_amount
columns.description: Numeric value stored as string -- see credit_limit note.

columns.name: fixed_interest_amount
columns.description: Numeric value stored as string -- see credit_limit note.

columns.name: total_fee
columns.description: Numeric value stored as string -- see credit_limit note.

columns.name: grand_total_due
columns.description: Numeric value stored as string -- see credit_limit note.

columns.name: penalty_charge
columns.description: Numeric value stored as string -- see credit_limit note.

columns.name: interest_due
columns.description: Numeric value stored as string -- see credit_limit note.

columns.name: auto_payment_account_number
columns.description: PII -- hashed with MD5 downstream in the safe Hive table.

columns.name: accrued_interest
columns.description: Numeric value stored as string -- see credit_limit note.

columns.name: co_owner
columns.description: Comma-separated CIFs of joint-account co-owners, e.g. 22222,3333
